questions.question: For F5: spec 051 becomes the authority and the axioms stay a standalone foundation. Which shape?

options.label: Self-contained 051 (Recommended)
options.description: Spec 051 states AX-1..8 as TREE-001..008 in its own right, with no 'restates research' clause. The research doc stays frozen with a one-line 'superseded by spec 051' status. The Lean and Alloy headers cite TREE IDs (via BK-437). Smallest change, one authority.
options.preview:
051 (authority)
  TREE-001..008  axioms
  TREE-009       Key
  TREE-010..012  lemmas
research  -> frozen, rationale
Lean/Alloy -> cite TREE-n

options.label: Axioms-only spec
options.description: Spec 051 holds only the axioms and the Key (TREE-001..009), so the foundation changes almost never. The lemmas L3..L5 move to a second spec (052) that cites the 051 axioms it derives from. The research doc is frozen. Cleanest isolation, but one more spec.
options.preview:
051 foundation
  TREE-001..009  axioms + Key
052 consequences
  L3..L5 -> cite TREE-n
research  -> frozen
Lean/Alloy -> cite TREE-n

options.label: Formal file is source
options.description: StoreAxioms.lean is the machine-checked source of the axioms. Spec 051 restates them, and a drift check keeps the AX-n and TREE-n pairs in sync. Strongest guarantee, but a new drift mechanism under DRIFT-RULES.
options.preview:
Lean  (source)
  axioms + proofs
051 restates -> drift check
research  -> frozen

questions.question: What would you like to clarify about the F5 shape before choosing?

options.label: What 'foundation' means
options.description: You'll say what 'axioms stay on their own' should mean in practice, for example a separate document, freedom from spec churn, or the formal proofs as the anchor.

options.label: Post first, decide later
options.description: Post the round-1 review now, with F5 worded as a diagnosis only, and settle the shape separately afterwards.
